sources.title: 用户提供的 InterCity 预订确认单（已核对）
sources.note: 事实来自用户提供的两页确认单及成功页；URL仅为运营平台入口，不含私密确认号。
sources.noteEn: Facts come from the supplied two-page confirmation and success page. The URL is the platform homepage, not the private booking.

days.highlight: 10:00从已订基督城住宿出发，驾驶及途中加油合计预留一小时，保留11:00还车和JQ236航班。入住后前往德文港，步行登维多利亚山看约19:30日落，计划20:15返航、21:00回酒店。接驳为计划预算而非实时车程，轮渡班次临行复核。
days.highlightEn: Leave the confirmed Christchurch stay at 10:00, allowing one hour for driving and refuelling before the booked 11:00 car return and JQ236. After hotel check-in, take the Devonport ferry and walk up Mount Victoria for sunset around 19:30, aiming for the 20:15 return ferry and the hotel by 21:00. Transfers are planning allowances, not live drive times; recheck sailings before departure.

alternative.title: 晚到或停航就留市中心
alternative.desc: 若17:30仍未安顿好，或轮渡停航、风雨不适合登山，取消当晚跨海，改酒店附近晚餐与休息；不赶末班船。入住时确认次晨霍比屯集合及10日退房后寄存到晚间是否可用。

alternativeEn.title: Stay downtown if delayed or sailings stop
alternativeEn.desc: If still unsettled at 17:30, sailings are cancelled, or wind and rain make the hill unsuitable, skip the crossing and have dinner near the hotel. Do not chase the last boat. Confirm tomorrow's Hobbiton meeting and whether luggage can be stored until the evening after checkout on 10 October.

events.text: 09:00早餐后收拾行李并退房，按房东说明交还钥匙；在10:00退房期限前完成装车，10:00从当前住宿出发。证件随身带，不再补景点。
events.textEn: From 09:00, have breakfast, pack and check out, returning the keys as instructed. Load the car before the 10:00 checkout deadline and leave the current stay at 10:00. Keep documents handy; no extra sightseeing stop.

events.summary: 住宿至机场还车点，含加油
events.summaryEn: Stay to airport car return, including refuelling
events.text: 按用户安排10:00从当日退房住宿出发，11:00在Budget基督城机场还车点交车。60分钟合计预留驾驶、按租约加油及还车准备，不代表纯驾驶需要一小时或已核验实时车程；解锁后使用该住宿位置导航，按路况与油量分配时间，必要时提前出发。
events.textEn: As requested, leave the checked-out stay at 10:00 and return the car to Budget Christchurch Airport at 11:00. The 60 minutes covers driving, refuelling under the rental agreement and return preparation, not a one-hour driving claim or a verified live ETA. Use the stay's location after unlocking, allow for traffic and fuel needs, and leave earlier if necessary.

events.text: 按11:00已订时间在Budget指定车位交车；卸净行李，拍下车况、油表及里程，按现场指示交钥匙，确认还车完成，再步行进入航站楼。
events.textEn: Return the car in the designated Budget bays for the booked 11:00 return. Remove all belongings, photograph the condition, fuel gauge and mileage, and hand over the keys as directed. Confirm completion before walking into the terminal.

events.summaryEn: Bag drop, security and a simple lunch
events.text: 还车后跟国内出发标识找Jetstar；柜台开放后尽早托运，建议12:30前办妥并安检，再简单午餐、补水。实际截止与登机口按航司通知，不把还车时间当值机开放时间。
events.textEn: After returning the car, follow domestic-departure signs to Jetstar. Drop bags promptly once available, aiming to finish by 12:30, then clear security and have a simple lunch and water. Follow the airline's actual deadlines and gate details; car-return time is not check-in opening time.

events.summaryEn: JQ236; second passenger's ticket to verify
events.text: JQ236 基督城 → 奥克兰（电子客票状态 OK）
events.textEn: JQ236 Christchurch → Auckland (e-ticket status OK)

events.summaryEn: Baggage and transfer to the hotel
events.text: 15:10落地后取齐行李并乘车前往已确认住宿；16:30为计划到店时间，不保证实际交通耗时。
events.textEn: Collect bags after the 15:10 arrival and transfer to the confirmed stay. The 16:30 hotel arrival is a planning target, not a guaranteed journey time.

events.text: 办理入住、放下行李并稍作休息；延误就取消德文港晚间行程。
events.textEn: Check in, leave bags and rest briefly. Skip the Devonport evening if delayed.

events.summary: 步行到市中心轮渡码头
events.text: 从当前酒店步行到Downtown Ferry Terminal，20分钟为含找路的计划预算。
events.textEn: Walk from the current hotel to Downtown Ferry Terminal; allow a planned 20 minutes including wayfinding.

events.text: 按现场标识前往Pier 4，施工可能需经Pier 6/7通道。两人各用自己的银行卡、Apple Pay或AT HOP，上下船均使用同一卡或设备；不能用同一非接触支付方式连续刷两人。没有独立支付方式就先买各自船票。
events.textEn: Follow current signs to Pier 4; works may require the Pier 6/7 gangway. Each traveller uses their own payment card, Apple Pay or AT HOP, tagging on and off with the same card or device. One contactless method cannot pay for both people. Buy separate tickets before boarding if needed.

events.text: 工作日时刻表列17:40开船、约17:52到德文港；未预订，不保证准点或不停航，临行复核AT。
events.textEn: The weekday timetable lists a 17:40 sailing arriving around 17:52. This is not booked or guaranteed to run on time; recheck AT before travelling.

events.text: 下船后往Victoria Road餐饮区短走。
events.textEn: After disembarking, walk towards the Victoria Road dining area.

events.text: 18:00至18:30在Victoria Road附近简单晚餐，未指定或预订餐厅；若等位过久改外带，18:30开始上山。
events.textEn: Have a simple dinner near Victoria Road from 18:00 to 18:30; no restaurant is booked. Switch to takeaway if queues are long and start uphill at 18:30.

events.text: 18:30经Victoria Road、Kerr Street步行上山，计划19:00到顶，提前留出取景时间；普通私家车不能驶上山顶，遵守现场步道和施工标识。
events.textEn: Start uphill via Victoria Road and Kerr Street at 18:30, aiming to reach the summit at 19:00 for more time to frame photos. Private vehicles cannot drive to the summit; follow current path and works signs.

events.summaryEn: Sunset and photos at the summit
events.text: 19:00至19:35在山顶看海港和城市全景、拍照。奥克兰10月8日日落约19:30，山顶地平线和天气会影响观感；19:35开始下山，夏季入口20:30关闭。
events.textEn: Enjoy harbour and city views and photos at the summit from 19:00 to 19:35. Auckland sunset on 8 October is around 19:30; the local horizon and weather affect the view. Start down at 19:35, before the summer gate closes at 20:30.

events.summaryEn: Walk down to the ferry terminal
events.text: 沿开放步道下山返回德文港码头，预留25分钟，不为追船走未开放捷径。
events.textEn: Allow 25 minutes to descend on open paths and return to the ferry terminal; do not use closed shortcuts to catch a boat.

events.text: 20:00到码头候船；如计划船班取消或错过，先看AT当日安排，不把后续班次当已确认。
events.textEn: Aim to reach the terminal at 20:00. If the planned ferry is cancelled or missed, check AT's current departures rather than assuming the next boat is confirmed.

events.text: 工作日时刻表列20:15从德文港开船、约20:27到市中心；以现场运营为准。
events.textEn: The weekday timetable lists 20:15 from Devonport, arriving downtown around 20:27; actual operations take precedence.

events.summary: 返回酒店，可步行或打车
events.summaryEn: Return to the hotel on foot or by taxi
events.text: 返航抵达Downtown Ferry Terminal后按体力和天气选择步行或出租车／网约车回原酒店，不限定步行。20:27至21:00合计33分钟是返程和等车预算，不是核验过的步行或行车耗时；未预订接送，车费和实际到达以现场为准。早到即可休息，准备次晨霍比屯行程。
events.textEn: After arriving at Downtown Ferry Terminal, walk or take a taxi/rideshare back to the same hotel according to energy and weather; walking is not compulsory. The 20:27–21:00 block is a 33-minute return and pickup allowance, not a verified walking or driving time. No transfer is booked; fares and arrival depend on actual conditions. Rest if back early and prepare for tomorrow's Hobbiton trip.

days.highlight: 霍比屯游览与自助午餐已预订并付款，2人，GreatSights Gray Line GA7657。10月9日07:00前在Sky City Bus Terminal（102 Hobson St）向司机报到，07:15出发、15:30计划返回同一车站。确认单未列中途各段精确时刻，09:30入园与13:15返程仍为计划分配，不保证酒店接送。
days.highlightEn: The Hobbiton tour and buffet lunch are booked and paid for two on GreatSights Gray Line GA7657. On 9 October, report to the driver at Sky City Bus Terminal, 102 Hobson St, by 07:00 for the 07:15 departure and scheduled 15:30 return to the same terminal. Intermediate timings are not listed: the 09:30 visit and 13:15 return leg remain planning estimates. Hotel transfers are not confirmed.

alternative.title: 延误先核对运营通知
alternative.desc: 当天查看InterCity延误信息；车身标识可能不同，向司机核对GA7657后上车。本单取消不退款，最晚出发前2小时可按条件修改，可能收改签费及差价；运营方取消时先联系处理，不自行租车追团。

alternativeEn.title: Check operator notices for delays
alternativeEn.desc: Check InterCity delay notices on the day. Vehicle branding may differ; confirm GA7657 with the driver before boarding. This fare is non-refundable on cancellation; conditional changes are allowed up to two hours before departure, with possible fees and fare differences. Contact the operator if it cancels rather than renting a car to chase the group.

events.text: 确认单要求至少提前15分钟到站。10月9日07:00前到Sky City Bus Terminal，102 Hobson St，向司机报到，07:15发车；携带私密确认单。订单起点是车站，不是酒店接车。
events.textEn: The confirmation requires arrival at least 15 minutes early. Reach Sky City Bus Terminal, 102 Hobson St, and report to the driver by 07:00 on 9 October for departure at 07:15. Carry the private confirmation; the booked pickup is the terminal, not the hotel.

events.summaryEn: GA7657 booked; rest on the coach
events.text: 2人Standard座位，GreatSights Gray Line GA7657，07:15从奥克兰发车；车身品牌可能不同，以司机核对为准。带水、雨具和步行鞋。09:30抵达是原计划估算，不是确认单给出的时刻。
events.textEn: Two Standard passengers on GreatSights Gray Line GA7657 depart Auckland at 07:15. Branding may differ; verify with the driver. Bring water, rain protection and walking shoes. Arrival at 09:30 remains a planning estimate, not a time shown on the confirmation.

events.text: 确认单包含2份Hobbiton Movie Set Tour (AM)。按司机安排在The Shire’s Rest集合并入场，不另外购买散客票；09:30仅为计划抵达时刻。
events.textEn: The confirmation includes two Hobbiton Movie Set Tour (AM) entries. Follow the driver's arrangements at The Shire's Rest and enter with the group, without buying separate tickets. The 09:30 arrival is only a planning estimate.

events.summary: 霍比屯导览与自助午餐
events.text: 已订产品Hobbiton Movie Set and Buffet Lunch包含2人上午游览及2份午餐，不再另安排午餐。09:30至13:15是合并计划窗口，具体导览、用餐及返程集合时间听从工作人员，不把未提供的餐厅或饮品细节当确认内容。
events.textEn: Hobbiton Movie Set and Buffet Lunch includes two morning tour entries and two lunches, so no separate lunch is needed. The combined 09:30–13:15 block is a planning window; follow staff for tour, meal and return-meeting times. Specific venues or drinks not listed on the confirmation are not treated as confirmed.

events.summaryEn: Return as directed by the driver
events.text: 提前到司机指定上车点，清点随身物品。13:15离开霍比屯是计划估算；确认单列15:30返回奥克兰Sky City Bus Terminal，路况仍可能影响实际到达。
events.textEn: Reach the boarding point ahead of the driver's announced meeting time and check belongings. Departure from Hobbiton at 13:15 is a planning estimate. The confirmation schedules Auckland Sky City Bus Terminal arrival at 15:30; traffic may change the actual arrival.

events.summaryEn: Scheduled return to the same terminal at 15:30
events.text: 确认单终点是Sky City Bus Terminal，102 Hobson St；15:30为计划返回时刻，全程8小时15分钟。取齐行李后自行回酒店，不等待未经确认的酒店接送。
events.textEn: The confirmed destination is Sky City Bus Terminal, 102 Hobson St, with scheduled return at 15:30 and total duration 8 hr 15 min. Collect belongings and return to the hotel independently; do not wait for an unconfirmed hotel transfer.

events.text: 从SkyCity车站步行或打车回同一酒店，按体力选择；15:45至16:30是含短休的预留，不是核验车程。确认单不承诺酒店送回；回去补水休息，并向前台确认次日退房后的行李寄存。
events.textEn: Walk or take a taxi from SkyCity to the same hotel according to energy. The 15:45–16:30 block includes a short rest and is not a verified journey time. The confirmation does not promise hotel drop-off. Rest, hydrate and confirm luggage storage after tomorrow's checkout.

days.highlight: 伊甸山、美术馆、皇后街、维达克港与天空塔顺路串联，分开交通、游览、用餐和休息。20:30从酒店出发，目标22:00到国际航站楼，距10月11日01:25起飞3小时25分；90分钟为含路况的计划缓冲，不是实测车程。
days.highlightEn: Link Mount Eden, the art gallery, Queen Street, Viaduct Harbour and Sky Tower with separate travel, visits, meals and rest. Leave the hotel at 20:30 and aim for the international terminal at 22:00, 3 hr 25 min before the 01:25 flight on 11 October. The 90 minutes is a planning buffer, not a measured drive.

alternative.title: 寄存、天气与交通备选
alternative.desc: 先确认行李可寄存到20:00；不能寄存则落实替代，不拖大箱登山。风雨大省略伊甸山，天空塔能见度差或关闭则改室内休息。19:30前复核路况与航司到场要求，必要时提前离城，不能再推迟机场目标。

alternativeEn.title: Luggage, weather and traffic alternatives
alternativeEn.desc: Confirm luggage storage until 20:00; arrange an alternative if unavailable rather than taking suitcases up the hill. Skip Mount Eden in poor weather and replace Sky Tower with indoor rest if visibility is poor or it closes. Recheck traffic and airline arrival instructions before 19:30, leaving earlier if needed rather than delaying the airport target.

links: 奥克兰国际出发与值机区
伊甸山开放与步行规定
奥克兰美术馆参观时间
linksEn: Auckland international departure and check-in zones

events.text: 早餐后退房，确认寄存是否可用、费用及20:00取回安排；证件和贵重物品随身带，未确认寄存先落实替代。
events.textEn: After breakfast, check out and confirm luggage storage, fees and collection at 20:00. Keep ID and valuables with you and arrange an alternative if storage is unavailable.

events.text: 11:45至13:15参观免费普通藏品展，不安排付费特展。背包、大包、购物袋和雨伞先到免费寄存处存放；个人手持摄影遵守展品标识，未经许可不用闪光灯或三脚架。开放时间10:00至17:00。
events.textEn: Visit the free general collection from 11:45 to 13:15; no paid special exhibition is planned. Check backpacks, large bags, shopping bags and umbrellas into the free cloakroom first. Follow artwork signs for personal handheld photography; no flash or tripods without permission. Open 10:00–17:00.

events.text: 从美术馆到皇后街附近吃午餐，45分钟包含短步行；按现场营业情况选择，未预订餐厅。
events.textEn: Have lunch near Queen Street after the gallery, with 45 minutes including the short walk. Choose an open venue; no restaurant is booked.

events.text: 20:30带齐行李乘车出发，22:00为目标到达时间；90分钟含等车和交通缓冲，不是已核验路程耗时。遇道路或航司更早要求时提前出发。
events.textEn: Leave with all bags at 20:30 and target arrival at 22:00. The 90 minutes includes traffic and pickup contingency, not a verified journey time. Leave earlier for road issues or airline instructions.

events.text: 22:00目标抵达，距次日01:25起飞3小时25分；看屏幕查马航柜台，不保证此时已开放或可托运。
events.textEn: Target arrival at 22:00, 3 hr 25 min before the next day's 01:25 departure. Find the Malaysia Airlines desk on the screens; counter opening and bag acceptance are not guaranteed.

events.text: 22:15起预留办理手续的时段，不表示柜台已确认开放。核对两段登机牌和行李直挂，按登机牌到口；马航托运至少提前60分钟，登机口起飞前30分钟关闭。
events.textEn: The block from 22:15 is a planning allowance, not confirmed desk opening. Verify both boarding passes and through-checked bags. Follow the boarding pass; Malaysia Airlines requires bag drop at least 60 minutes before departure and closes the gate 30 minutes before departure.

events.summaryEn: Taxi to the Mount Eden entrance
events.text: 从酒店打车到伊甸山开放的步行入口，30分钟为叫车和路况预算，不导航到山顶。
events.textEn: Take a taxi from the hotel to an open walking entrance; 30 minutes allows for pickup and traffic. Do not direct the car to the summit.

events.text: 预留一小时上下步道、看火山口和城市全景；夏季入口07:00至20:30开放，山顶禁止普通机动车。沿指定步道，不进入火山口。
events.textEn: Allow one hour for the walking paths, crater views and city panorama. Summer gates open 07:00–20:30; private motor vehicles cannot access the summit. Stay on designated paths and out of the crater.

events.text: 下山后叫车至1 Kitchener Street美术馆入口，30分钟含叫车预算。
events.textEn: After descending, take a taxi to the gallery entrance at 1 Kitchener Street, allowing a planned 30 minutes including pickup.

events.text: 沿皇后街向海港方向走，购物按各店实际营业时间，不把整条街视为统一营业场馆。
events.textEn: Walk down Queen Street towards the harbour. Shop opening times vary; the street has no single venue-wide trading schedule.

events.text: 从皇后街海港端走到维达克港，看港湾和船只，停留拍照；这一小时包含到达的步行。
events.textEn: Walk from the harbour end of Queen Street to Viaduct Harbour for boats, waterfront views and photos. The hour includes the approach walk.

events.text: 在港边营业中的咖啡或餐饮店坐休补水，未预订；保留休息，不再添加景点。
events.textEn: Sit down for refreshments at an open harbour venue; nothing is booked. Keep the rest break instead of adding another sight.

events.text: 从海港步行至Victoria Street与Federal Street附近的天空塔入口，20分钟为计划预算。
events.textEn: Walk from the harbour to the Sky Tower entrance near Victoria and Federal Streets; allow a planned 20 minutes.

events.text: 17:00至18:15为拟参观时段，尚未购票。10月周六开放09:30至21:30、最晚20:45入场；恶劣天气或私人活动可能关闭，能见度差则省略。
events.textEn: 17:00–18:15 is a planned visit, with no ticket purchased. October Saturday hours are 09:30–21:30, last entry 20:45. Weather or private events may close the tower; skip it if visibility is poor.

events.text: 天空塔下来后在Federal Street附近晚餐；餐厅未预订，19:30结束并复核机场路况。
events.textEn: After Sky Tower, have dinner near Federal Street. No table is booked; finish at 19:30 and recheck airport traffic.

events.text: 回当日退房的原酒店取行李，按已确认寄存时限返回；并非再次入住或有客房休息。
events.textEn: Return to the checked-out hotel for luggage within the confirmed collection window. This does not imply another check-in or access to a room.

events.summaryEn: Collect luggage, repack and wait for pickup
events.text: 20:00取回全部行李，整理购物品与证件、等车；20:30按计划出发。若寄存窗口更早，则相应提前取回。
events.textEn: Collect every bag at 20:00, repack purchases, check documents and wait for pickup. Leave at 20:30; collect bags earlier if the agreed storage window requires it.

days.highlight: KUL当地转机13小时10分：07:55到达先核对续程与行李；建议09:00早餐、10:00—12:00补眠、12:30午餐，下午坐休与短走交替；18:00晚餐，19:30复核并转往登机区。留在禁区，不安排出机场。
days.highlightEn: The KUL connection is 13 hr 10 min in local time. After the 07:55 arrival, verify the onward flight and baggage. Suggested rhythm: breakfast 09:00, nap 10:00–12:00, lunch 12:30, alternating seated rest and short walks in the afternoon, dinner 18:00, and recheck the gate and head to the departure area at 19:30. Stay airside; no airport exit is planned.

alternative.title: 睡不好就询问禁区休息室
alternative.desc: 若座椅无法休息，可询问T1 Sama-Sama Express Sky Suite休息室的入内条件、可用性与费用后自决，未预订且不保证可进；航班变化先找转机服务台，不自行走入境通道。

alternativeEn.title: Ask about an airside lounge if needed
alternativeEn.desc: If terminal seating is unsuitable for rest, ask T1 Sama-Sama Express Sky Suite about access conditions, availability and cost before deciding. It is not booked and access is not guaranteed. For flight changes, ask the transfer desk first rather than entering immigration on your own.

events.summaryEn: Reach the gate early as instructed
events.text: 00:30前后按登机牌要求到口，复核MH0132、证件与随身物品；马航公布登机口起飞前30分钟关闭，按现有航班推算00:55，不要等到窗口末尾才找登机口。
events.textEn: Be at the gate around 00:30 or earlier if the boarding pass requires it, checking MH0132, ID and hand luggage. Malaysia Airlines states that gates close 30 minutes before departure, which is 00:55 for the recorded flight. Do not wait until the end of this block to find the gate.

events.textEn: MH0522 Kuala Lumpur T1 → Shenzhen; arrive at 01:15 the next day

days.highlight: 本日全部使用深圳当地时间。01:15抵达后只做入境、取行李和安全返家；02:30出机场、03:15到家均是原计划估计，不是通关或车程保证。
days.highlightEn: All times today are local to Shenzhen. After the 01:15 arrival, focus only on entry formalities, baggage and getting home safely. Leaving the airport at 02:30 and reaching home at 03:15 remain planning estimates, not guarantees of processing or travel time.

alternative.title: 落地或取行李延误
alternative.desc: 通知接机方按实际进度调整；行李异常先处理再离开，不以原计划时刻催赶。返家后直接休息，不追加上午活动。

alternativeEn.title: Arrival or baggage delays
alternativeEn.desc: Keep whoever is meeting you updated on actual progress. Handle baggage issues before leaving and do not rush to preserve the original target times. Go straight to rest at home without adding morning activities.

events.summary: 入境、取行李与异常处理
events.summaryEn: Entry, baggage collection and any issues
events.text: 下机后跟国际到达指示办理入境，取齐托运行李并核对外观；有缺失或损坏先到行李服务台处理。02:30仅是原计划完成点，排队或行李延迟就顺延返家。
events.textEn: Follow international-arrival signs for entry formalities, collect every checked bag and inspect its condition. Report missing or damaged bags at the baggage service desk first. The original 02:30 completion target is only an estimate; queues or baggage delays push the trip home later.

events.text: 取齐行李后再确认接机或出租车上车点，按机场现场标识走；两人疲劳时不自行驾车。返家约45分钟仅沿用原计划估计，等车和路况变化不以赶03:15到家为目标。
events.textEn: After collecting all bags, confirm the pickup or taxi meeting point and follow airport signs. Avoid driving yourselves if both are tired. The roughly 45-minute trip home is only the existing planning estimate; do not rush to meet 03:15 if waiting or traffic adds time.

events.summaryEn: Check in with family and catch up on sleep
events.text: 到家先报平安、喝水洗漱，把证件与贵重物品收好就休息；非必要行李醒后再整理，上午不安排必须准时出门的事项，实际到家晚就顺延休息。
events.textEn: Once home, let family know, have water, wash and secure your documents and valuables before resting. Leave non-essential unpacking until after sleep and avoid fixed morning commitments. A later arrival simply means resting later.
